name: Donchian-70 breakout + own SMA200 + BTC200 hysteresis (long only)
one_line: Close breaks prior 70-day high while above own SMA200 and BTC above its SMA200 (+/-3% hysteresis); 25-day hold.

source.license: no LICENSE file in repo; owner's own repository (owner-provided reference, do not redistribute)

status_in_source: hold ('most interesting'); rejected after multiple-testing correction (R15) which the owner's own notes call structurally unpassable
idea: Enter when close exceeds the previous 70-day high and the asset closes above its own SMA200; market regime filter: BTC above SMA200 with +/-3% hysteresis band to avoid flapping; inverse-volatility sizing (risk budget 1.0, cap 25% per asset); fixed 25-day expiry; no stop/take-profit.

rules.name: btc_regime_filter
rules.description: BTC close > SMA200*(1+3%) to enable, < SMA200*(1-3%) to disable (hysteresis)

rationale: Slow channel breakout filtered by trend and market regime reduces whipsaw; 55-day variant failed period-split tests, 70/25 passed 7/8.
evidence: Gross CAGR +68.6%, MDD 35.9%, Sharpe 1.463, 258 trades. Passed 5 robustness checks (7/8 period splits) but only 1 of 239 combinations tried.
limitations: selection bias, survivorship bias acknowledged by source

pipeline_fit.notes: For BTC use own SMA200 only (BTC regime filter is the same series). For ETH the BTC regime filter would need BTC data (not available in generate_signals(df)).
